_README: TEMPLATE. Copy to spikes/evidence/<scenario_id>-<device_id>.json, set scenario_id, fill every field from a PHYSICAL device run, delete all keys starting with underscore. Unfilled (null) fields are INVALID and the scenario stays PENDING. Never set synthetic=true for real evidence; synthetic and emulator/simulator files never count.

REM-IOS-00.title: Tauri iOS build installs and launches offline on a physical iPhone
REM-IOS-00.pass_criteria: All four checks true on a physical iPhone. Record Tauri, plugin, Xcode, iOS versions in the evidence notes.

REM-IOS-01.title: Notification permission states are reported correctly and the ledger stays usable
REM-IOS-01.pass_criteria: All checks true across not-determined, granted, denied, and re-enabled-in-Settings.

REM-IOS-02.title: One-shot delivery, app backgrounded, screen locked
REM-IOS-02.pass_criteria: At least 19 of 20 trials observed within 5 minutes after target (5 s early tolerance), zero duplicate, zero stale.

REM-IOS-03.title: One-shot delivery after the user force-quits the app
REM-IOS-03.pass_criteria: At least 19 of 20 trials observed within 5 minutes after target, zero duplicate, zero stale.

REM-IOS-04.title: Daily wall-clock request delivery (calendar trigger) on 20 consecutive occurrences
REM-IOS-04.pass_criteria: At least 19 of 20 occurrences observed within 5 minutes after the local target, zero duplicate, zero stale. Simulated clock days are allowed only if flagged in notes.

REM-IOS-05.title: Schedule edit with an old request pending: cancel and replace
REM-IOS-05.pass_criteria: Old request gone from the pending list, expected IDs present, zero stale and zero duplicate deliveries.

REM-IOS-06.title: Reboot with pending requests
REM-IOS-06.pass_criteria: Pending requests survive, deliver within 5 minutes, and reconcile adds no duplicates.

REM-IOS-07.title: Time-zone change while the app is closed: trigger behavior and reconciliation
REM-IOS-07.pass_criteria: Behavior of both trigger types is recorded and, after reconcile on next launch, there are no stale or duplicate requests and no past snapshot changed.

REM-IOS-08.title: Manual clock jump with an elapsed-time trigger pending
REM-IOS-08.pass_criteria: Plugin 'at' schedules map to elapsed-time triggers in source; the recorded fire time shows whether a clock jump moves them, and the app reconciles without rewriting history.

REM-IOS-09.title: Pending-request capacity
REM-IOS-09.pass_criteria: Measured capacity recorded; the app's rolling-window cap is not above it. Apple docs fetched do not state a cap.

REM-IOS-10.title: Tap, dismiss, and action never write a dose
REM-IOS-10.pass_criteria: Ledger dose-event count and occurrence status are unchanged after every interaction.

REM-IOS-11.title: Lock-screen privacy with generic text
REM-IOS-11.pass_criteria: No medication name, dose, or condition is visible on the locked screen under default and Show Previews settings.
